question: True or false: if a child needs data from its parent, define the child inside the parent so it can read it.
say: True or false: if a child needs data from its parent, define the child inside the parent so it can read the data.
explanation: False. Declare every component at the top level and pass the data down with props instead of nesting definitions.
explainSay: False. Keep every component at the top level, and pass the data down with props.
